message.content:
1 lb. Loaf
Jalapeno Bread
Ingredients 1 lb.
Water (80°F – 90°F) ½ cup
Oil 1 ½ tbsp.
Canned Whole Kernel Corn, well drained ½ cup
Jalapeno Peppers, well drained 2 TBL
Sugar ¾ tsp.
Salt ¼ tsp.
Bread Four 2 cups
Bread Machine Yeast ¾ tsp.
Corn Meal ⅓ cup
Fresh Cilantro, chopped 2 tsp.
Active Dry Yeast 1 ¾ tsp.
DIRECTIONS
  • Place ingredients in the pan of the bread machine in the order the ingredients are listed.
  • Insert bread pan securely into baking chamber; close lid. Plug unit into wall outlet.
  • Select white bread cycle, crust color, and the correct loaf size; press Start.
  • When the bread is finished and all cycles are complete, remove the pan from the chamber (using potholders).
  • Remove the bread from the pan and allow to cool (at least 20 minutes).
